title: What Do Compressed Multilingual Machine Translation Models Forget?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating compressed models on the FLORES-101 benchmark using spBLEU and ChrF metrics to assess performance disparities and degradation across high, medium, low, and very-low resource language pairs.
Using the MT-Gender benchmark to measure gender bias in machine translation by comparing the model's F1 scores on male and female subsets across pro-stereotypical and anti-stereotypical contexts.

Evaluating models on the DiBiMT benchmark to measure word sense disambiguation biases, calculating error rates based on how often the model incorrectly selects a more frequent word sense over the correct one.
